LanguageData.Gun_Galil_ARM_556mm_RWP.label: Galil ARM 5.56mm
LanguageData.Gun_Galil_ARM_556mm_RWP.description: The Galil ARM is a versatile 5.56mm assault rifle known for its reliability in harsh environments. Equipped with a bipod and integrated carrying handle, it offers improved stability during sustained fire, making it an excellent choice for mid to long-range engagements. This rugged weapon delivers a balance of accuracy and firepower, suited for colonies facing frequent raids or skirmishes.
